evidence_boundaries: RoboTwin Table 6 and denoising Table 7 each cover 50 tasks but the note uses averages and selected configurations rather than reproducing unreadable dense tables.
A800 controlled ablation latency and RTX 4090 final deployment latency are not treated as directly additive algorithm gains.
The 98 ms protocol follows one warm-up, caches text embeddings, and excludes instruction encoding, observation acquisition, and robot execution.
Real-world success uses four tasks and 20 trials per task; no statistical significance is claimed.
The paper does not expose enough low-level action/control detail for a complete hardware-stack reproduction.
